edition.notes: The title page identifies Braun, the publisher, and the year. This first edition is a material-culture and historical witness, not an official liturgical book. Claims about the 1962-horizon ceremony remain controlled by the governing Roman books.
edition.title: Handbuch der Paramentik

passages.context: Braun describes the contemporary gremial as a cloth about 80 centimetres square spread over a seated bishop's lap. He distinguishes the silk pontifical-Mass gremial from washable linen lap-cloths used for distributions and anointments, explains their protective function, and surveys the gremial's history.
passages.notes: Both printed pages were inspected in the exact scan. This passage supports approximate square dimensions, lap placement, the silk-versus-linen functional distinction, and the absence of any need to depict fastening ties. Its historical synthesis does not establish the official ceremonial moments independently of the Caeremoniale Episcoporum.

work.author: Joseph Braun, S.J.
work.description: A historical handbook of Roman liturgical textiles and vesture, including their contemporary construction, use, and material history. It can control morphology and historical practice, but not supersede an edition-identified liturgical book.
work.title: Handbuch der Paramentik
